Not recorded by design: Montenegro's '82,9% increase compared to 2023' (no 2023 count, and no indicator for change in decisions); Serbia's 'over 200 Russian nationals' naturalised 'in the interest of the Republic' since 2022 (not an investment programme in programs.csv); Albania (scheme suspended, no numbers). European Parliament resolution of 9 March 2022 on CBI/RBI schemes (OJ C 347, 9.9.2022, pp. 96-108; 13 PDF pages): recitals, 27 paragraphs and an annex of proposals (phase-out of CBI by 2025, RBI regulation, visa-suspension for third countries with CBI). Programme numbers: EPRS EAVA estimates for 2011-2019 (already recorded); Cyprus 6,779 passports 2007-2020 and the announced revocation of 39 investors and six family members (added); minimum RBI investment range EUR 60,000 (Latvia) to EUR 1,250,000 (Netherlands) (added as terms). Events already recorded: phase-out call, Montenegro, Bulgaria letter. Other dates (Cyprus suspension 13 Oct 2020, Commission infringements Oct 2020, Commission package 20 July 2021) are already events from primary sources.
